title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Secondary School Applicants  Outside Ontario
Secondary school
students
applying from outside an Ontario Secondary School (OSS) will be required to
present evidence of equivalent standing, including those required courses
listed in the section
Ontario
Secondary School Applicants Program Specific Requirements
. Academic
standings deemed to be equivalent are listed in the
Undergraduate
Admissions Toolkit
and in the
International
Admissions Toolkit
.
